concerns.text: T009 (ResourceMonitor implementation) is marked [P] (parallel-safe), but T011 (Integration) explicitly depends on T009. Furthermore, T009b (Execution) depends on T009. If T009 is truly parallel-safe with other Setup tasks, T011 cannot be scheduled until T009 completes. The [P] tag on T009 is misleading in the context of the Phase 2 dependency chain where T011 is marked non-[P] due to T009. More critically, T009b depends on T009, but T009b is also marked [P]. T009b cannot run in parallel with T009. The [P] tag on T009b is a violation of the 'Producer before consumer' rule if interpreted as 'can run with T009'.

T015c (Validate Age/Gender) and T015d (Covariate Fallback) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) relative to each other, but T015d explicitly depends on T015c ('Dependency: T015c'). A task cannot be parallel-safe with its own dependency. T015d must be sequential to T015c. The [P] tag on T015d is incorrect.

T018b (Halt on Zero Effective Subjects) depends on T015c (Covariate Exclusion) and T018a (Motion Exclusion). T018b is marked [P]. However, T018b consumes the output of T015c and T018a. If T015c and T018a are running in parallel (as implied by their [P] tags and lack of mutual dependency), T018b cannot start until BOTH complete. Marking T018b as [P] implies it has no dependencies or can run concurrently with its producers, which is false. It must be sequential to the completion of T015c and T018a.

T016c (Halt on Zero Valid Subjects) depends on T015. T016c is marked [P]. T015 is a large implementation task. T016c cannot run in parallel with T015 as it consumes T015's output (valid_subjects.json). The [P] tag on T016c is a violation of 'Producer before consumer'.
T019a (Verify Preprocessing Stats) depends on T017b. T019a is marked [P]. T017b generates the artifact T019a verifies. T019a cannot run in parallel with T017b. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T019b (Validate SC-001) depends on T019a. T019b is marked [P]. T019b consumes T019a's output. It cannot be parallel-safe with T019a.
T019c (Validate Spec-Task Alignment) depends on T019b. T019c is marked [P]. It consumes T019b's output. It cannot be parallel-safe.
T031b (Halt on Zero Valid Scores) depends on T031a. T031b is marked [P]. It consumes T031a's output. It cannot be parallel-safe.
T031d (Multiple Linear Regression) depends on T015c and T015d. T031d is marked [P]. It consumes outputs from T015c/d. It cannot be parallel-safe with them.
T032 (Bonferroni Correction) depends on T031c. T032 is marked [P]. It consumes T031c's output. It cannot be parallel-safe.
T033 (Calculate Effect Sizes) depends on T032. T033 is marked [P]. It consumes T032's output. It cannot be parallel-safe.
T034 (Generate Scatter Plot) depends on T033. T034 is marked [P]. It consumes T033's output. It cannot be parallel-safe.
T035 (Generate Summary Report) depends on T034. T035 is marked [P]. It consumes T034's output. It cannot be parallel-safe.
T036 (Generate Resource Profile) depends on T035. T036 is marked [P]. It consumes T035's output. It cannot be parallel-safe.
T030 (Integration Test) depends on T035. T030 is marked [P]. It consumes T035's output. It cannot be parallel-safe.
